name: Material Arrangement Scan
purpose: Apply the practice-theory lens (Shove, Pantzar & Watson 2012) to why a routine sticks: scan the user's environment through materials/competences/meanings, detect shared elements across practice bundles, and propose arrangement changes. Cues supplement, never replace, practice (T2R row 94); meaning-making is user-owned (Charter: preserve judgment); identity-level reframes require explicit confirmation (Phase 11 confirmed-Q2 path).

governance.rule: No AtomicOp proposes meaning reframes at identity level without explicit user confirmation (Phase 11 confirmed-Q2 path); materials/arrangement proposals are suggestions — the user rearranges, the agent never rearranges for them.
